title: Deflecting the Value Compass: Interacting with Large Language Models Temporarily Shifts Human Value Priorities Toward Personal Focus

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring shifts in human value priorities using Schwartz's Portrait Values Questionnaire (PVQ-RR) before and after users interact with LLMs on advice-giving moral dilemmas, specifically observing shifts toward WEIRD-aligned (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) 'personal focus' values.
